spans.s: सिद्ध (I) a. (f. द्धा) 1. Accomplished, effected, completed; 2. obtained, acquired, gained, e.g. सिद्धप्रायं नः समीहितम्; 3. succeeded, successful; 4. settled, established, नैसर्गिकी सुरभिणः कुसुमस्य सिद्धाः मूर्ध्निस्थितिर्न चरनैरवताडनानि M.M.ix.; 5. substantiated, demonstrated, proved, साक्षिप्रत्ययसिद्धानि कार्याणि M.viii.178; 6. valid (as a rule of grammar); 7. admitted to be true or right; 8. adjudicated, decided (as a law-suit); 9. paid, liquidated, settled (as a debt); 10. ready (as money); 11. thoroughly prepared, concocted, compounded (as drugs); 12. cooked, dressed; 13. matured, ripened, ripe; 14. subjugated, subdued (by magical power); 15. thoroughly skilled or well-versed (in any art), जयंति ते सुकृतिनो रससिद्धाः Bhartr.ii.24; 16. perfected or sanctified (by penance or austerities); 17. emancipated; 18. endowed with supernatural faculties or powers; 19. sacred, holy, pious; 20. divine, immortal, eternal; 21. well-known, eminent, celebrated; 22. shining, splendid.

सिद्ध (II) m. 1. A semidivine being supposed to be of great purity and holiness and said to be specially characterized by eight supernatural faculties, त्वामासाद्य स्तनितसमये मानयिष्यंति सिद्धाः Megh.i.21; 2. an inspired sage or seer; 3. any sage or seer; 4. an adept in magical or mystical arts; 5. a law suit, a judicial trial; 6. a sort of hard sugar.

सिद्ध (I) a. (f. द्धा) 1. Accomplished, effected, completed; 2. obtained, acquired, gained, e.g. सिद्धप्रायं नः समीहितम्; 3. succeeded, successful; 4. settled, established, नैसर्गिकी सुरभिणः कुसुमस्य सिद्धाः मूर्ध्निस्थितिर्न चरनैरवताडनानि M.M.ix.; 5. substantiated, demonstrated, proved, साक्षिप्रत्ययसिद्धानि कार्याणि M.viii.178; 6. valid (as a rule of grammar); 7. admitted to be true or right; 8. adjudicated, decided (as a law-suit); 9. paid, liquidated, settled (as a debt); 10. ready (as money); 11. thoroughly prepared, concocted, compounded (as drugs); 12. cooked, dressed; 13. matured, ripened, ripe; 14. subjugated, subdued (by magical power); 15. thoroughly skilled or well-versed (in any art), जयंति ते सुकृतिनो रससिद्धाः Bhartr.ii.24; 16. perfected or sanctified (by penance or austerities); 17. emancipated; 18. endowed with supernatural faculties or powers; 19. sacred, holy, pious; 20. divine, immortal, eternal; 21. well-known, eminent, celebrated; 22. shining, splendid.

सिद्ध-अंत m. 1. the demonstrated conclusion of an argument, the true logical conclusion, (following on the refutation of the pūrva paksha); 2. established truth, proved fact, settled doctrine, dogma, axiom; 3. any fixed or established text-book resting on conclusive arguments.
सिद्ध-अंत˚कोटि f. the point in an argument which is regarded as a logical conclusion.
सिद्ध-अन्न n. dressed food, cooked victuals.
सिद्ध-अर्थ (I) a. one who has accomplished his purpose, successful, prosperous.
सिद्ध-अर्थ (II) m. 1. an epithet of Buddha; 2. white mustard.
सिद्ध-आसन n. a particular posture in religious meditation.
सिद्ध-गंगा, -नदी, -सिंधु f. the celestial Ganges.
सिद्ध-गंगा, -नदी, -सिंधु f. the celestial Ganges.
सिद्ध-गंगा, -नदी, -सिंधु f. the celestial Ganges.
सिद्ध-ग्रह m. name of a particular kind of madness.
सिद्ध-जल n. water of boiled rice, sour rice-gruel.
सिद्ध-ता f. perfection, completion.
सिद्ध-त्व n. perfection, completion.
सिद्ध-धातु m. quick-silver.
सिद्ध-पक्ष m. the established or logical side of an argument.
सिद्ध-प्रयोजन m. white mustard.
सिद्ध-रस (I) a. having perfected metallic fluids, mineral.
सिद्ध-रस (II) m. 1. quick-silver; 2. an alchemist.
सिद्ध-संकल्प a. one who has accomplished his wishes.
सिद्ध-स्थाली f. the pot of a seer (fabled as a vessel gifted with the property of overflowing with any kind of food at the wish of the possessor).

सिद्धि f. 1. Accomplishment, fulfilment, perfection, complete attainment (of any object), अदूरवर्तिनीं सिद्धिं राजन् विगणयात्मनः R.i.87; 2. success, prosperity, well-being; 3. settlement, establishment; 4. substantiation, proof, indisputable conclusion; 5. validity (of a rule or law); 6. certainty, truth, accuracy, correctness; 7. decision, adjudication, determination (of a law-suit); 8. payment, liquidation (of a debt); 9. the solution of a problem; 10. preparation, cooking; 11. readiness; 12. complete sanctification; 13. final emancipation, supreme felicity, beatitude; 14. the acquisition of supernatural powers by magical means; 15. marvellous skill or capability; 16. good effect or result; 17. understanding, intellect; 18. concealment, vanishing, making oneself invisible; 19. a superhuman power or faculty, the same as विभूति q.v.; 20. a particular kind of Yoga.
सिद्धि-योग m. a particular auspicious conjunction of the planets.
सीद्य n. Slothfulness, idleness, indolence.
